name: Switch
statusNote: The handle ("thumb" in older MDC docs) now changes size across three states — unselected, selected, pressed — instead of two, adding a pressed-state "squish" that baseline M3 did not have.
summary: A binary on/off control whose effect applies immediately, with no separate save or confirm step. Prefer switch over checkbox for a standalone setting; prefer checkbox for list selection.

inputs.name: onCheckedChange
inputs.description: Called when the switch is clicked, with the new value. Omit to make it non-interactive; it still renders in its current visual state.

inputs.name: thumbContent
inputs.description: Optional small icon centered inside the handle, indicating on/off. Its presence forces the handle to render at the larger selected diameter even while unselected. Any on/off icon swap animation is the caller's responsibility; the switch does not crossfade or animate this content itself.

inputs.name: enabled
inputs.description: Disables interaction and applies the disabled colors when false.

anatomy.name: Track
anatomy.description: The stadium-shaped background. Outlined only while unselected; the outline is covered by the fill the instant the track becomes selected-colored.

anatomy.name: Handle
anatomy.description: The circular knob that slides between the track's ends. Changes size and color by state.

anatomy.name: Icon
anatomy.description: Small glyph centered inside the handle, indicating on/off. Supplied by the caller as arbitrary content; not required.

anatomy.name: State layer
anatomy.description: Circular hover/focus/pressed indicator centered on the handle, unbounded by the track.

layout.text: The track is track-width by track-height; its outline, when visible, is track-outline-width.

The handle's diameter is state-dependent: unselected-handle-width/height at rest unselected, selected-handle-width/height at rest selected, and pressed-handle-width/height while pressed in either state. Pressing briefly grows the handle to its largest size regardless of on/off.
If thumbContent (an icon) is supplied, the handle renders at the selected diameter even while unselected: icon presence forces the larger handle size. This rule is not expressed in any token.

The handle is centered in the track: its inset from the track edge is (track-height minus the handle's current rendered size) / 2, recomputed every time the rendered size changes, so the handle stays vertically and horizontally centered at every size.

Exception while pressed: the handle does not stay centered. It snaps to sit exactly track-outline-width from the near track edge, the edge it is travelling toward, producing a "hug the edge" pinch rather than a centered position.

Travel distance between the unselected and selected rest positions is computed once from the selected handle size and a derived padding constant ((track-width minus selected-handle-width) minus ((track-height minus selected-handle-height) / 2)), not from whichever size is currently rendered. Do not recompute travel distance per current handle size.

states.text: Handle and icon draw in selected-handle-color and selected-icon-color; track fills with selected-track-color. The selected track border is hard-coded fully transparent, so the unselected outline disappears the instant the track becomes selected-colored because the fill covers it, rather than animating out separately.

states.label: unselected
states.text: Handle, icon and track draw in their unselected-* color tokens; the track shows its outline at track-outline-width.
Handle size and offset both snap instantly, with no easing, instead of animating: the press-squish is immediate and only the later release/settle motion is springy.
Colors are not animated between enabled and disabled; treat the transition as an instant cut, matching checkbox and radio button. No separate disabled-transition motion is defined for switch.

Hovering, focusing or pressing does not recolor the track, handle or icon: comp.switch defines per-interaction color tokens (selected-hover-track-color, selected-focus-handle-color, unselected-pressed-icon-color, etc.), but the pinned Compose implementation's default SwitchColors never reads them. Interaction feedback is the ripple/state-layer overlay on the handle, plus the handle's own size-based press squish.

behaviour.text: Handle size and position both animate on a fast-spatial spring, except while pressed, where both snap instantly with no easing.
Toggling the switch calls onCheckedChange(!checked); the effect should apply immediately with no separate confirmation step.

Icon content, if supplied, is arbitrary caller-provided composable content and is not internally crossfaded or animated by the switch; any on/off icon swap animation must be implemented by the icon content itself.

keyboard: Tab moves focus to the switch.
semantics: The focus ring/state layer is drawn on the handle at its current position and size, not on the track.
The effect of toggling is immediate and requires no separate confirmation; do not gate a switch behind a save action.

notes.text: comp.switch defines per-interaction-state colors for track, handle and icon (selected-hover-track-color, selected-focus-handle-color, selected-pressed-icon-color, and the unselected equivalents), but SwitchColors in the pinned Compose implementation only branches on enabled and checked; none of the hover/focus/pressed variants are read. Interaction feedback is the ripple overlay on the handle plus the handle's own size change, not a recolor.
comp.switch.focus-indicator-color is never referenced by Switch.kt; the inset focus ring (when the ripple theme uses one) is drawn with the track's own shape and no distinct color token.

comp.switch.icon-handle-width/height (24dp) exist as tokens but are not referenced by any code path in Switch.kt at the pinned commit; they duplicate the selected-handle size and are unused. Do not treat them as a distinct required size.

The token comp.switch.unselected-focus-track-outline-color is used unconditionally as the base unselected track border color in SwitchDefaults.colors(), not only while focused, despite its name. Its "focus" naming is misleading: it is the plain resting unselected outline color.

Do not assume a fixed two-state handle diameter: the size machine has three tiers (unselected/selected/pressed) plus an icon-presence override, and travel distance is always computed from the selected size regardless of which size is currently rendered.
The pressed-state offset formula reuses track-outline-width as the pinch gap; if that token changes, both the resting track border width and the pressed-handle inset move together.
